prerequisites: Mathematical fundamentals and fundamentals of Linear Algebra

learning_outcomes.text: Students can classify and categorize any robot system, both regarding its purpose (industrial and service robots) and its degree of autonomy.
In the area of industrial robotics, students are able to mathematically model standard manipulators and arbitrary kinematic chains and calculate the corresponding forward kinematics.
Students can program the calculation of forward kinematics using standard programming languages.
In the area of service robotics, students know the challenges and current developments regarding mobility and multimodal sensor technology for environmental perception.
Regarding autonomy, students learn approaches to AI-driven control systems for robotic systems.
Students have also dealt with ethical and societal aspects of the use of robotic systems and are able to independently assess their use regarding societal consequences.

syllabus_topics: Introduction of the terms Robotics, Industrial Robots, Service Robots, Autonomous Robots
Ethical aspects of the use of robot systems
assessment_rules: The prerequisite for the award of credit points is a passed module examination and proof of performance. The grade's relevance for the final grade is according to the study and examination regulations (SPO).
